master_file: 02 - 120 X 48 Inch - 2 Nos Double Side GSB - SRI KAVI STEELS.cdr
note: SUPERSEDED by panel_sequence below (see CLAUDE.md 'Wide-board panel sequence' and 'Example-based layout engine' for why: derive_brand_rules.py's automatic cluster-size matching that produced this groups[] section mismatched the enlarged badge for a duplicate of cluster_id 1, an error independently reproduced by Phase 2's example engine - kept only because compute_layout still supports this schema as a fallback for a future brand that doesn't need panel_sequence's enlarge/substitute case). groups[].bbox_mm is in the MASTER's own mm coordinates and is used to re-match a master's top-level logo shapes to a group at layout time (nearest bbox centre) - there is no stable shape id/name in these untagged files.

panel_sequence.note: Hand-verified against real rendered PNGs (dataset_analysis/compare/*/real.png for 02-180x48 aspect=3.75, 06-180x60 aspect=3.0, 11-216x48 aspect=4.5, 11-240x60 aspect=4.0), not derived by automatic matching - see CLAUDE.md 'Wide-board panel sequence'. tamil_card = the master's left Tamil-wordmark card (never repeats, kept near its master size). roof_graphic = the master's centre white house-silhouette graphic (the true repeat element, used as a spacer/filler). enlarged_badge_card = the master's small top-right English 'Dalmia Bharat Cement' badge, enlarged to roughly the Tamil card's height and substituted in as a second, equal-sized card (never repeats, never further enlarged). Each group's size_table gives (target_h_frac, target_w_frac, target_cy_frac) - fractions of the TARGET page height/width regardless of tiling axis (only validated for horizontal tiling - all 4 sampled wide boards tile on x) - AT EACH SAMPLED ASPECT, read directly off that board's own real render, not averaged: a flat average across all 4 was tried first and measurably didn't fit every board (06 180x60's enlarged badge overflowed its cell). target_w_frac is stored explicitly rather than derived from the group's master bbox aspect ratio: the real enlarged badge card's width/height ratio does NOT match the master badge shape's own ratio (it's redesigned to roughly match the Tamil card's proportions, not algebraically scaled up) - deriving width from height via the master aspect ratio also overflowed the cell. layout._interp_size_table linearly interpolates between the two nearest sampled aspects at layout time, clamping (not extrapolating) outside [3.0, 4.5]; layout._place_panel_sequence then scales by min(implied-scale-from-height, implied-scale-from-width) so a group whose real proportions don't match its master shape's own ratio still never overflows its cell. aspect_split is bounded only to 'somewhere in (4.0, 4.5]' by the single sample at 4.5 that showed a 4th panel - not fitted further without more real wide files at intermediate aspects.

groups.cx_table_note: Measured directly from all 4 real wide dalmia boards (added after finding _place_panel_sequence's axis='x' horizontal placement had never been verified against a real file the way target_cy_frac/h_frac/w_frac were): each group's real horizontal centre is a roughly constant fraction of new_w per aspect, NOT 'cell i of n' (evenly dividing the page into n equal slots, the previous unmeasured assumption) - that put every group 840-1100mm too far left on every sampled board despite target_cy_frac already being accurate to ~16mm. See app.layout._interp_cx_frac; falls back to the old even-cell math when a group config has no cx_table (e.g. every hand-built test_layout.py fixture).

groups.card_from_note: The master's small top-right badge (bare icon+text, no card - see 'Wide-board panel sequence') is redesigned in every real wide file into a white card matching the Tamil card's size/shadow, with the badge's own icon+text centred inside - not a bare enlarged logo, which is what a uniform scale-up of the master's badge shapes alone produces. card_content_frac is measured from the master's own Tamil card: its icon+Tamil-text content occupies 80.4% of the card's width and 50.0% of its height, centred at (45.8%, 56.4%) of the card's own box - applied here to size/centre this group's own icon+English-text content inside the borrowed card.

groups.repeat_table_note: count = how many copies of this cluster's bounding-box size were found (size-matched, tolerance 35%) in the real designer file at that new_w/new_h aspect ratio, plus the master itself at its own aspect (always count=1). Derived from backend/dataset_analysis/dumps, not a formula - interpolate/extrapolate by nearest aspect at layout time.
